mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_task_definition (id, task_type, display_name, handler_ref, max_attempts, timeout_seconds, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskType}, #{displayName}, #{handlerRef}, #{maxAttempts}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, display_name, handler_ref, max_attempts, timeout_seconds, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_task_definition ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_task_job (id, task_type, payload, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at, interval_seconds, created_by_issuer, created_by_type, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskType}, #{payloadJson}::jsonb, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt}, #{intervalSeconds}, #{createdByIssuer}, #{createdByType}, #{createdById}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, payload::text AS payload, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at, interval_seconds, locked_by, locked_at, last_error, created_by_issuer, created_by_type, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM ainer_task_job WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_task_job SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_run_at = COALESCE(#{nextRunAt}, next_run_at), locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED','EXHAUSTED','CANCELLED') THEN #{now} ELSE completed_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE ainer_task_job j SET status = 'PENDING', locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} FROM ainer_task_definition d WHERE j.task_type = d.task_type AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.locked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => d.timeout_seconds * #{multiplier})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_task_audit (id, job_id, event, attempt, actor_issuer, actor_type, actor_id, detail, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobId}, #{event}, #{attempt}, #{actorIssuer}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{detail}, #{occurredAt})
